fato_historico: 2008: Spanair Flight 5022, from Madrid, Spain to Gran Canaria, skids off the runway and crashes at Barajas Airport. Of the 172 people on board, 146 die immediately, and eight more later die of injuries sustained in the crash.
energia_do_dia: Today carries a heavy resonance of fragility, perhaps reminding us that life is a precious, fleeting journey. Like the wings of a traveler, our spirits may need extra grounding now. Consider this a time to cherish your connections and find beauty in the present moment, holding those you love close as you navigate your own grand adventure.
frase_do_dia: Every step you take is a beautiful part of your unique cosmic story.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of energy and universal balance.
conselho: Focus on the beauty of the present and treasure every simple heartbeat today.
